title: Ezekiel's visitors appear as wheels covered in eyes

tellings.quote: Ezekiel's visitors arrive as interlocking wheels covered in eyes, wrapped in fire and storm.

plain: In the Bible, the prophet Ezekiel, writing during the exile in Babylon, describes visitors who arrive as 'interlocking wheels covered in eyes, wrapped in fire and storm.' Michels gives this in his own narration, from the King James Bible of 1611. He sets it among other ancient accounts of strange beings, as though it could be an early record of a close encounter.
